text:
Sam: Quick plan — staggered burst for the model launch next Wed. Need X + LinkedIn assets and two engagement follow-ups. Who can own scheduling?
Ava: I can take scheduling. I'll use Buffer for X and Hootsuite for LinkedIn. What's the primary CTA — webinar signup or docs?
Sam: Primary CTA = webinar signup. Also anchor a short link to benchmark blog after wave 1. Webinar landing: https://redwood.ai/launch-webinar
Ravi: I can draft copy. Propose A/B test: short punchy X copy vs threaded explainer. Measure RTs, replies, and CTR to webinar.
Julian: Design can deliver hero image + 16:9 social card + 1 vertical for stories. Need final copy by Mon 11am PST to hit creative queue.
Marta: Growth — inbound leads should map to SFDC campaign "ModelLaunch_Mar" and route to queue `launch-inbound`. SDRs: @LeadsOps to confirm.
Sam: @Marta noted. Also include UTM params: utm_source=twitter|linkedin&utm_campaign=model_launch
Ava: Schedule plan draft:
```
date,time,platform,copy_type,asset
2026-04-08,09:00,linkedin,lead-post,hero-16x9
2026-04-08,09:15,x,short,card-1
2026-04-08,12:00,x,thread-start,thread-1
2026-04-09,10:00,linkedin,followup,card-2
```
Julian: Sizes: hero-16x9 (1200x675), card-1 (1200x675), thread images 1200x675. Also deliver a 1:1 square for boosted posts.
Ravi: Draft copy snippets:
- Short X: "New: faster, cheaper LLM inference across hosted & private deployments. Join our launch webinar. 🔗"
- Thread starter (longer): "We built a serving runtime that makes inference predictable at scale. Thread 🧵👇"
Sam: Engagement follow-up templates (two quick replies):
1) "Thanks for the question — we'll cover latency & cost breakdowns in the webinar. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/launch-webinar"
2) "Here's a short benchmark summary and comparison table: [link to blog] — happy to DM deeper details."
Marta: Can we pin 2 replies to the X thread for the first 48h and have SDRs monitor replies for high-intent leads? :eyes:
Ava: Yes. I'll set pinned replies and assign @LeadsOps a daily digest from replies via Zapier.
scheduler-bot: Scheduled posts created in Buffer: 3 items. Next run at 2026-04-08 09:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Awesome. Action items:
- Ravi: final copy by Mon 11am PST
- Julian: assets by Mon 5pm PST
- Ava: schedule and pin replies
- Marta: confirm SFDC routing with LeadsOps
Any blockers?
Julian: Quick one — need logo high-res and brand-approved alt copy. @Sam can you drop those?
Sam: Dropping files in #assets now. Thanks team :rocket:
Marta: I'll ping LeadsOps and post confirmation here when routing is set.
Ravi: I'll post A/B variations in this thread for review.
Ava: Ack, will double-check UTM formatting and timezone windows.
Sam: Great. We'll reconvene Tue 10am PT for final go/no-go. :calendar:
